ov: محارب الصحراء (الإنجليزية: Desert Warrior) فيلم تاريخي ملحمي مستوحى من أحداث يوم ذي قار، من إخراج روبرت ويات كما قام كذلك بكتابة النص مع إريكا بيني. الفيلم من بطولة أنتوني ماكي، وعائشة هارت، وبن كينغسلي، وشارلتو كوبلي، وغسان مسعود، وسامي بوعجيلة، ولميس عمار، وجيزا روهريج. كما أنه من إنتاج استوديوهات مركز تلفزيون الشرق الأوسط بالتعاون مع شركتي "JB Pictures" و"AGC Studios" بميزانية تُقدّر بحوالي 140 مليون دولار، وقد صُوِّرَت الأحداث الرئيسية منه في نيوم وتبوك شمال غربي السعودية.
plotEn:
During the early 7th century, Emperor Kisra of the Persian Sassanian Empire sought to gain control of Arabia by forcing its kings to send their wives as his concubines. One of them, King Numan of the Lakhmids, refused, and he and his daughter Hind were subsequently chased across the desert by agents of the Sassanian emperor led by the general Jalabzeen. They stumble onto a bandit and desert vagabond named Hanzala who seemed hesitant to help them at first until Numan bribes him with royal gold and subsequently agrees to help them escape from the agents. The agents continue to pursue the trio until they reach the territory of the Shaybani tribe by its chieftain Hani who welcomes Jalabzeen until he convinces him to go away as Numan and Hind are now considered guests in his tribe. Frustrated, Jalabzeen and his men attack a few Shaybani tribesmen later that night, forcing Hani to eventually hand over Numan to Jalabzeen to be taken back to Emperor Kisra to prevent further killings upon the tribe. 
The incident at the Shaybani tribe forces Hanzala and the surviving Princess Hind to flee once again, and once finally away, Hanzala teaches Hind basic combat skills to prepare for the fight against the Persian occupation of their land.
